mcqs.question: Which statement best describes the property of "definite shape" in solids?

options.A: A solid takes the shape of the container it is placed in.
options.B: A solid keeps its own shape even when the container is changed.
options.C: A solid can be easily stretched into any form.
options.D: A solid changes shape when heated.

mcqs.answer: A solid keeps its own shape even when the container is changed.
mcqs.explanation: Solids have a definite shape, meaning they retain their own shape regardless of the container. Option B states this correctly. Option A describes liquids, C describes rubber-like materials, and D describes thermal expansion, not the basic definition of definite shape.

mcqs.question: A wooden block is placed in a glass jar. Which observation correctly shows the property of "definite volume" of the block?

options.A: The block spreads out to fill the entire jar.
options.B: The block changes its size to match the jar’s shape.
options.C: The block occupies the same amount of space, no matter the shape of the jar.
options.D: The block disappears when the jar is turned upside down.

mcqs.answer: The block occupies the same amount of space, no matter the shape of the jar.
mcqs.explanation: Solids have a definite volume; they occupy a fixed amount of space irrespective of the container. Option C reflects this. Options A and B describe liquids, while D is impossible.

mcqs.question: Which of the following examples best illustrates the rigidity of a solid?

options.A: A rubber band stretched and then released.
options.B: A wooden block that does not change shape when pressed gently.

mcqs.answer: A wooden block that does not change shape when pressed gently.
mcqs.explanation: Rigidity means a solid resists deformation. A wooden block retains its shape under gentle pressure, showing rigidity. A rubber band is flexible, water flows, and air expands, none of which demonstrate rigidity.

mcqs.question: A student lists the following items as solids: ice, a rock, water, and a pencil. Which item in the list is NOT a solid?
mcqs.explanation: Ice, rock, and a pencil are all solids. Water at room temperature is a liquid, so it is not a solid. Hence option C is correct.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements reflects a common misconception about the shape of solids?

options.A: A solid keeps its own shape regardless of the container.
options.B: A solid can be molded into any shape like clay.
options.C: A solid does not change shape unless a force strong enough to break it is applied.
options.D: A solid’s shape is independent of external pressure.

mcqs.answer: A solid can be molded into any shape like clay.
mcqs.explanation: Solids have a definite shape; they cannot be molded like clay without breaking or changing their structure. Option B is the misconception. Options A, C, and D correctly describe solid behavior.

mcqs.question: If a kilogram of sand is poured from a rectangular container into a cylindrical container, what happens to the volume of the sand?

options.A: The volume increases because the new container is taller.
options.B: The volume decreases because the sand settles more tightly.
options.C: The volume stays the same because sand, as a solid collection, has a definite volume.
options.D: The volume changes depending on the shape of the container.

mcqs.answer: The volume stays the same because sand, as a solid collection, has a definite volume.
mcqs.explanation: The sand particles together occupy a fixed amount of space; changing the shape of the container does not alter the total volume. Therefore option C is correct. Options A, B, and D incorrectly suggest volume depends on container shape.

mcqs.question: Which comparison correctly describes the rigidity of solids compared to liquids?

options.A: Both solids and liquids are equally rigid and resist shape change.
options.B: Solids are rigid and retain shape, while liquids flow and take the shape of their container.
options.C: Liquids are more rigid than solids because they have definite shape.
options.D: Solids are less rigid than gases because they can be compressed easily.

mcqs.answer: Solids are rigid and retain shape, while liquids flow and take the shape of their container.
mcqs.explanation: Solids exhibit rigidity, maintaining shape; liquids lack rigidity and adapt to container shape. Option B captures this contrast. Options A, C, and D are inaccurate statements about rigidity.

mcqs.question: In a competitive exam, a question asks: "Which of the following is NOT a solid at room temperature?" Choose the correct answer.
mcqs.explanation: Mercury is a liquid at room temperature, whereas a metal nail, glass bottle, and candle wax (solid at typical room temperature) are solids. Hence option D is the correct answer.
